Verdict

No confirmed malicious supply-chain compromise indicators were found. Overall risk: **info**.

Malicious Supply-Chain Indicators

No confirmed malicious supply-chain indicators.

Automatic Execution Paths

  • src/shadow/sdk/_bootstrap/sitecustomize.py exists, but its comments state that it is intended to act as a Python startup hook only when shadow record prepends that directory to PYTHONPATH for a child process.
  • This sitecustomize.py imports shadow.sdk._autostart; according to the comments, it starts a session only when SHADOW_SESSION_OUTPUT is set and otherwise does nothing.
  • Based on the provided evidence, there is no indication of install-time execution, global execution on normal Python interpreter startup, .pth-based execution, or malicious setup.py/PEP 517 build-hook behavior.
  • Normal CLI entry points or user-invoked shadow record behavior were not treated as malicious supply-chain auto-execution evidence.

Theft / Exfiltration / Persistence / Lateral Movement / Obfuscation

  • **Credential harvesting:** Not confirmed. ANTHROPIC_API_KEY and OPENAI_API_KEY appear to be normal documented application credentials for LLM SDK use. The provided content does not show broad environment-variable harvesting or discovery of .env, SSH keys, cloud credentials, registry tokens, or similar secrets.
  • **CI/GitHub tokens:** Mentions and use of ACTIONS_ID_TOKEN_REQUEST_URL/TOKEN appear related to sigstore/keyless signing in certify_sign.py; no token theft or external exfiltration evidence was identified.
  • **Archive staging / exfiltration:** Apart from apparent false positives on Rust iterator .zip(), there is no evidence of compressing/staging harvested files or uploading them to attacker-controlled endpoints.
  • **Persistence:** No evidence of systemd units, cron jobs, launch agents, shell profile edits, or self-reinstall loops.
  • **Lateral movement:** No evidence of Kubernetes token use, Docker socket access, cloud metadata access, GitHub Actions workflow injection, or package-registry token reuse.
  • **Obfuscation/loader:** No evidence of base64/zlib/marshal/eval/exec payload loaders, downloader stubs, or similar obfuscation. Pre-scan hits involving “cryptography,” regexes, and “ConversableAgent” appear to be documentation or normal code in context.

Distribution Integrity Anomalies

  • The provided files do not show hidden payloads, unexplained native binaries, typosquatting evidence, suspicious C2 domains, or sudden malicious dependency insertion.
  • The included crates/shadow-core/ Rust sources and README are consistent with the package’s described Rust core functionality.
  • curl https://sh.rustup.rs | sh appears in README Rust installation instructions and is not an install hook or automatic payload.

Additional Verification Needed

  • The review input is limited to selected text from 6 of 145 files plus pre-scan results; a full review of all source files, build scripts, and package metadata was not completed.
  • The actual pyproject.toml build backend configuration, full dependency history, wheel-vs-sdist differences, and any bundled native binaries should be checked separately.
  • The body of shadow.sdk._autostart was not provided, so the detailed behavior imported by sitecustomize.py requires separate verification.
